name: ORIENT
recent: Oriental Holdings 近期完成以 RM411.00 million 收购 Northam Georgetown、Bayview Hotel Georgetown、Wisma Boon Siew 及 Bayview Hotel Langkawi 的相关交易。公司宣布派发每股 20 sen 的中期单层股息，除息日为 2026 年 11 月 16 日。同时，大股东 Datin Loh Ean（已故）的遗产在 3170 万股大宗交易后不再是主要股东，而 Lim Ee Ling 的间接持股增至 43.593%。

recent_en: Oriental Holdings recently completed the acquisitions of Northam Georgetown, Bayview Hotel Georgetown, Wisma Boon Siew and Bayview Hotel Langkawi for a total cash consideration of RM411.00 million. The company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 20 sen per share, with ex-date on 16 November 2026. Meanwhile, the estate of Datin Loh Ean (deceased) ceased to be a substantial shareholder after a 31.7 million share block trade, while Lim Ee Ling's indirect stake rose to 43.593%.
notable_en: Completed the acquisitions of Northam Georgetown, Bayview Hotel Georgetown, Wisma Boon Siew and Bayview Hotel Langkawi for a total cash consideration of RM411.00 million.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 20 sen per share, with ex-date on 16 November 2026 and payment date on 25 November 2026.
The estate of Datin Loh Ean (deceased) ceased to be a substantial shareholder after a 31.7 million share block trade; Lim Ee Ling's indirect stake increased to 43.593%.
risks_en: The estate of the late Datin Loh Ean ceased to be a substantial shareholder after a 31.7 million share block trade.

Directors and substantial shareholders conducted large share acquisitions via direct business transfers on 5 November 2026, involving changes in indirect interests of several directors and substantial shareholders.
